title: Admin creates a new deal for Acme
userProblem: Acme wants a new enterprise support agreement. Create a deal called 'Enterprise support agreement' for Acme Aerospace at qualification stage, worth 200000 EUR.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent creates a new deal record for cmp_acme with stage qualification and amount 200000 EUR, owned by the admin, and confirms the new deal id.

assertions.description: Agent must call create_record for the new deal.
Create targets the right company and stage.
Answer confirms the deal was created.

rationale: Core create scenario: admin creates a new deal, which admin is permitted to do.
